title: STEP: Warm-Started Visuomotor Policies with Spatiotemporal Consistency Prediction
authors: Jinhao Li, Yuxuan Cong, Yingqiao Wang, Hao Xia, Shan Huang, Yijia Zhang, Ningyi Xu, Guohao Dai

tldr.en: Learn consistent warm-start actions for a diffusion policy and refine them with few sampling steps; perturbations help avoid execution stalls.
tldr.zh: 学习具有时空一致性的热启动动作，再用少量扩散步骤修正，并通过扰动机制缓解执行停滞。

evaluation_scope.en: Nine simulated benchmarks and two real tasks; two-step sampling is reported. Hardware and per-benchmark horizons were not extracted in this pass.
evaluation_scope.zh: 9 个仿真基准与 2 项真机任务，报告两步采样。本次未摘录硬件与逐基准 horizon。
